🚨 *GLOBAL POLICY TRIGGERS ALERT*
• *Source/Speaker:* US President Donald Trump and the United States Trade Representative \(USTR\)
• *Announcement:* The US has imposed new Section 301 tariffs of 10\% on Indian goods, citing concerns related to forced labor\. This action, directed by President Donald Trump, was finalized by the USTR after India secured a lower rate through discussions on labor standards, down from an initially proposed 12\.5\%\.
• *Market Stance:* 🔴 BEARISH

📊 *CONFIDENCE LEVEL:* HIGH \(90\% \- Tariffs of 10\% have been officially imposed by the USTR, directed by President Trump, and are effective\.\)

🎯 *INDIAN MARKET IMPACT:*
• *Vulnerable Sectors:* Textiles, Auto Components, Chemicals, Gems \& Jewellery
• *Strategic Tailwinds:* None
• *Expected FII Sentiment:* Net Outflows \(The imposition of tariffs by a major trading partner like the US creates uncertainty and directly impacts the competitiveness of Indian exports, leading to a risk\-off sentiment for FIIs\.\)

💡 *TACTICAL ACTIONABLE OUTCOME:* Indian fund managers should review portfolios for significant exposure to export\-oriented sectors impacted by the 10\% US tariffs and consider rebalancing towards domestically focused industries or those with diversified export markets\.
